proposals.before: The Extended Records of Kara Khoto preserve many accounts from the dynasty's founding, naming Grand Preceptor Ahai, Grand Tutor Tughuai, and Grand Guardian Ming'an; other official reports mention them as well, though the order and dates of their appointments and dismissals cannot be recovered. They are therefore noted here.

They are therefore noted here.
